questions.question: SOCAN’s lawsuit accuses Suno of infringing on the rights of more than how many Canadian artists?
questions.explanation: SOCAN says Suno infringed on the rights of more than 150 Canadian artists without consent or proper compensation.

questions.question: How much financing did Vancouver-based Metavista3D secure to help commercialize its glasses-free 3D display technology?
questions.explanation: Metavista3D secured $6 million from Sorbie Bornholm and Sorbie Investments for commercialization, patents, and working capital.

questions.question: Which spin-off milestone did UBC reach after adding 15 new ventures in 2026?
questions.explanation: The 15-company cohort brought UBC to its 302nd spin-off company.

questions.question: How many Alberta innovation projects shared nearly $51 million in new ERA funding?
questions.explanation: Emissions Reduction Alberta committed just under $51 million to 16 projects intended to cut emissions and grow the economy.

questions.question: What new name did agriculture-lending software company Landjourney adopt?
questions.explanation: Landjourney rebranded as Sweet Technologies while raising capital to expand its SweetAg lending platform.

questions.question: Which new Kobalt.io partner specializes in application and cloud security consulting?
questions.explanation: Forward Security is the application and cloud security consultancy in Kobalt.io’s newly announced partner group.

questions.question: Where does Toronto startup Meissner plan to test its top superconductor candidates?
questions.explanation: Meissner plans to test candidates at the University of Waterloo’s Quantum-Nano Fabrication and Characterization Facility.

questions.question: According to InDro Robotics, how long could the Talos truck power a 50-bed field hospital?
questions.explanation: InDro CEO Philip Reece said Talos carries enough onboard power to run a 50-bed field hospital for 10 days.
